verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a product with public docs could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no OpenAPI spec, and nothing else in the pack documents agent-oriented docs. Features like web scraping or MCP compatibility are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
